resources.string: HydraDragon monitors browser URLs to protect you from malicious websites.
Developers: Musayev Yusif and Emirhan Ucan

This device has ROOT access.

HydraDragon Antivirus does NOT support root-level features. USB debugging (ADB) is also not supported for production use.

⚠️ STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Remove root access and disable USB debugging before using this app. Running on a rooted device with ADB enabled severely compromises your security.

If you believe malware has rooted your device without your knowledge, you may continue with LIMITED protection.

HydraDragon can run a LOCAL DNS-filtering VPN to block malicious / phishing sites. It does NOT proxy, decrypt or inspect your traffic — only DNS lookups are filtered, on-device. Android shows a key icon while it\'s active.
